features.title: Comfort that rises with you
features.text: Our high backrest, filled with soft Recron fibre, is designed to embrace your upper body. It supports your shoulders and neck while offering a gentle sink-in feel—so you can unwind deeply, every time you take a seat.

features.title: A seat that moves with you
features.text: Pocket springs beneath high-resilience foam add a soft bounce and subtle give—creating that “just right” blend of support and comfort, no matter how long you sit.

features.title: Support your lower back will thank you for
features.text: Enhanced lumbar padding helps maintain your natural posture, easing pressure where it matters most—so you feel less fatigue and more balance in your body, even after hours of relaxation.

features.title: Armrests shaped to welcome you in
features.text: Our sofa features broad, angular armrests that support your arms in a natural resting position. Their design encourages better posture while adding clean-lined elegance to your space.

features.title: Easy upkeep, elevated look
features.text: Upholstered in soft synthetic leather, our sofa is built to resist stains, scuffs and daily wear—giving you that premium look with far less effort.

features.title: Built to lift your space—literally
features.text: Our sofa stands tall on sturdy PVC legs, giving it both strength and subtle elevation. This thoughtful height not only makes everyday cleaning easier but also creates an airy, open look that lightens up your room—without compromising on stability.
